guard: catalog refresh is lazy for every target, operational catalog targets are account-scoped, sibling failures warn instead of refusing, and setup describes the selected remote mesh
command: pnpm -s typecheck && pnpm -s smoke:meshes-registry && pnpm -s smoke:setup-destination
why: The regressions are independent: restoring a non-catalog early return prevents lazy refresh, dropping account scope lets a dead sibling refuse a catalog operation, throwing on every result restores the global refusal, and using the cwd default restores the misleading ready card.
Each mutation is compile-clean and must redden the named existing-suite cell.

mutations.name: restore the non-catalog selection early return
mutations.find:
const target = named ?? selected;
  const targetCatalog = !diagnostics && target?.origin === "catalog" ? target : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: non-catalog selection refreshes every account and keeps the selection
mutations.cell: non-catalog selection refreshes every account and keeps the selection

mutations.name: drop the selected catalog account scope
mutations.expectRed: catalog selection scopes refresh to its account and ignores a dead sibling
mutations.cell: catalog selection scopes refresh to its account and ignores a dead sibling

mutations.name: make every sibling account failure fatal again
mutations.find:
if (targetCatalog && failures.length)
    throw new Error(failures.map((r) => `space catalog for ${r.account.idpUrl} failed: ${r.error}`).join("; "));
mutations.replace:
if (failures.length)
    throw new Error(failures.map((r) => `space catalog for ${r.account.idpUrl} failed: ${r.error}`).join("; "));
mutations.expectRed: non-catalog selection refreshes every account and keeps the selection
mutations.cell: non-catalog selection refreshes every account and keeps the selection

mutations.name: restore the cwd default on the setup ready card
mutations.expectRed: the ready card names the selected remote mesh and does not recommend starting a local one
mutations.cell: the ready card names the selected remote mesh and does not recommend starting a local one
